name: codex-claude-code-bridge
description: Run Claude Code from deterministic Codex commands with synchronous final results, native runtime approvals, visible conversation inheritance, and multi-image clipboard handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Claude Code commands with synchronous results and native approvals.
interface.longDescription: A local bridge that intercepts explicit claude commands (plus /claude aliases in the Codex App) before the Codex model, waits for Claude Code's final result in the same hook, pauses only for real runtime approvals or questions, inherits visible Codex conversation, queues multiple Windows clipboard images without manual saving, and keeps a guarded MCP/Skill fallback for model-directed use.
